description: List movies available in this neighborhood (only on sites with movies_enabled). Returns now-showing films (with actual showtimes at local cinemas), coming-soon films, and streaming availability. Includes title, genres, TMDB rating, runtime, and detail URL.

status.description: Filter by status. "now_showing" = films with upcoming showtimes at local cinemas. "coming_soon" = unreleased or not yet playing locally. "streaming" = available on streaming services in Brazil. "all" = full catalog (default).

name: list_movies
